intro: Razorhide is a repeatable ritual offered by the captive quilboar Mangletooth in Camp Taurajo. By offering him blood shards infused with the life essence of the Ancient boar god Agamaggan, warriors and wanderers can gain a powerful blessing of hardened skin and resilience before heading into combat.

clips.title: Progress
paras: All those who enter battle have need of protection. Their bones must be strong. Their skin tough. My tribe knows this as well, and to add to the natural protection our quills and hide give us, we often call upon Agamaggan to protect us from harm before we go to war.
Bring me 4 blood shards and I will grant you the same protection.
